entries.title: Network Path and Filter Enhancements for the Global Insights Dashboard
body: The Global Insights dashboard includes Sankey visualizations to evaluate latency experience on network paths for devices connected between Zscaler and App Connectors.
The dashboard also includes the following filters as part of the enhancement to focus on crucial details:
- Uplink
- Sessions
- Region
The following are renamed for clarification and better representation:
- Wi-Fi vs. Cellular Health by Region section to Uplink Health by Region
- Avg p90 (ms) to Latency (P90 ms)
- Device Share to Session Share
The Health scores are updated to better represent Good, Okay, and Bad health for internet access.
See image.
To learn more, see Viewing the Global Insights Dashboard.

entries.title: Global Insights Dashboard Enhancements
body: The Global Insights dashboard enhancements include:
- A comparison table between Wi-Fi and cellular access on devices
- An ISP Leaderboard that displays the most impacted internet service providers (ISPs)
The interactive Threat Detector map is no longer available, which improves the dashboard's usability and its focus on actionable insights.
See image.
To learn more, see Viewing the Global Insights Dashboard.

entries.title: Browser Access
body: Leverage Browser Access to enforce strict user authentication by using your identity provider, which issues a JSON Web Token that limits web application access.
See image.
Contact Zscaler Support to enable this feature.
To learn more, see About Browser Access.

entries.title: Global Insights Dashboard
body: Access the Global Insights dashboard to locate and monitor where your users' devices are distributed, view an overview of their digital experience performance, and see global threats that Zscaler detects and prevents.
See image.
To learn more, see Viewing the Global Insights Dashboard.

entries.title: Device Profile
body: Enable more granular security controls by creating a device profile to maintain and enforce access to your application segments. After you create a device profile, you can then create an access policy that uses various criteria (e.g., hardware identifier, OS version) to evaluate each device that accesses your application segments.
See image.
To learn more, see About Device Profile and About Access Policy.

entries.title: Client Monitoring Dashboard
body: The Client Monitoring dashboard provides a high-level overview of users and their mobile devices by capturing important device details on usage, locations, operating systems, and hardware.
See image.
To learn more, see Viewing the Client Monitoring Dashboard.

entries.title: Additional Data Path Tunnel Capabilities
body: Additional data path tunnel capabilities are added to increase support for tunnel evaluation.
To learn more, see Developer Reference.

entries.title: ZSDK Private Service Edges and Disaster Recovery
body: ZSDK Private Service Edges provide safe and secure access to your private applications. Disaster recovery allows your users to access applications in the event of a disruption that impacts Zscaler. When configuring a ZSDK Private Service Edge, you can enable Disaster Recovery for a ZSDK Private Service Edge group.
See image.
To learn more, see About ZSDK Private Service Edges and Viewing Disaster Recovery.

entries.title: ZSDK Platform 2.0 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Support ZSDK integration with React Native. To learn more, see ZSDK Integration Guide Using React Native.
- Merge Prelogin tunnel and Zero Trust tunnel into User tunnel.
- Update notifications for appropriate naming conventions.
